issue_context.title: Bug: Home auto refresh doesn't work
issue_context.body:
### Description

When I switch to the home page in an existing or new tab. The drive widget is not refreshed when it should be, based on https://github.com/files-community/Files/pull/16732#issuecomment-2615080531 , but can still be done with the button or F5.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open the home page
2. Note the free space on the C drive
3. Download a large file
4. Navigate to the home page in the same or new tab
5. See free space hasn't changed

### Files Version

3.9.1.0

### Windows Version

10.0.26100.2894

### User ID

_No response_

### Log File

[debug.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18997125/debug.log)
comments:
Are you switching tabs or navigating backward/forward?
In the former case it should not be updated by design
https://github.com/files-community/Files/pull/16732#discussion_r1934066570
I'm not switching to a tab that already on home. If I use the sidebar and click home or open a new tab which goes to home by default, I would expect it to update.

> If I use the sidebar and click home which goes to home by default, I would expect it to update.

I found a fix.
Just to be sure, if you're already on the `HomePage` and click the `Home` button in the sidebar, would you expect the widgets to update?
No, but if it does that would be fine too.

> No, but if it does that would be fine too.

Ok, I'll ask @yaira2 because implementing this would require adding a different handling for home page only
